name: Rogue Bruiser
body:
Although most rogues rely on sly tricks and graceful maneuvers, some rogues eschew these trappings in favor of brute strength.

Relying on brawn rather than brains, bruisers crush enemies with powerful strikes rather than out maneuver their opponents.

Strength Training (Ex)

At 1st level, a bruiser adds her Strength bonus (if any) on all Fortitude saves that she makes.

In addition, she can use her Strength modifier in place of her Dexterity when determining the effects of her ninja or rogue class features. At 3rd level, 11th level, and 19th level, the bruiser gains a bonus feat, chosen from the following list: Cleave, Cleaving Finish, Dazing Assult, Furious Focus, Great Cleave, Improved Cleaving Finish, Power Attack, or Stunning Assault. She must meet the feat’s prerequisites.

This ability replaces finesse training.
